source.name: Open Food Facts — source-separated community product subset
source.attribution: Contains information from Open Food Facts, made available under the Open Database License (ODbL).
source.quality: Community labels imported, not independent current-package verification. Valid identity, explicit source serving unit, available nutrients and import arithmetic checked.
source.scope: Source-attributed Canadian products plus a curated brand selection in other supported markets. Explicit source servings and quality gates apply; not full retailer inventory.
source.images: No product images copied. OFF images have separate CC BY-SA and package rights.

searchPolicy: Exact barcode first. Brand/name tokens and partial words; updated source versions first. Market, recipe/formulation and package identities remain distinct.
availability: Community source labels, not live retailer inventory or independent package verification.
